schema_notes: v2 (2026-09-14): observed_evidence is {gate, review}: gate lines are '[clause] message' as the gate prints them and must cover exactly failed_contract; review lines are human findings. Every record pins asset_sha256; a changed file fails the gate until re-adjudicated. class_rules globs match per path segment ('*' within a segment, '**' across segments); a path matched by rules for two classes is an error. app/ci/dxf_catalog_schema.py validates all of this at load time and rejects any other schema name: bump the name whenever the structure changes.
purpose: Declarative classification and quarantine register for the DXF catalog. Read by app/ci/dxf_catalog_policy.py for both catalog gates (app/ci/check_dxf_files.py and scripts/validate_dxf_assets.py). A quarantine record never passes a file: it names the failed contract, keeps manufacturing authority BLOCKED, and states the exit condition. manufacturing_authority is recorded and enforced in CI; runtime paths do not yet read it. Known runtime consumer: generators/body_generator.py and lespaul_body_generator.py load LesPaul_CAM_Closed.dxf (UNADJUDICATED here) as the Les Paul G-code template without reading this registry.
rulings: 2026-09-13 owner ruling: the Files gate is an export-readiness gate; files that fall short are fixed or recorded with reason and owner, never downgraded to warnings

2026-09-14 owner ruling: folder + layer define asset class, declared here rather than as exceptions in validator code; BODY_POINTS is reference/measurement data; WIRING_CHANNEL open paths are not declared valid until the CAM consumer is traced; owner stream is DXF Catalog Integrity

2026-09-14 owner ruling: only R12 is approved; R2000 is allowed only in the canonical vectorizer system (bucket 1: blueprint reader mode cam_ready_r2000, auth-gated, routers/blueprint/vectorize_router.py). Stored catalog files are therefore R12 only

version_policy.basis: docs/governance/VECTORIZER_CANONICAL_PATHS.md (cam_ready_r2000 = paid tier, auth required); docs/governance/DXF_TRANSLATOR_SERIALIZATION_POLICY.md (R12 free tier / R2000 paid tier translators); docs/handoffs/DEV_ORDER_2026-06-04_R2000_BUCKET2_REVERT.md (ungated R2000 is drift). The catalog is not the canonical vectorizer, so it gets no R2000 allowance.

clauses.nonempty: modelspace has at least one entity
clauses.geometry_present: at least one LWPOLYLINE, POLYLINE, LINE, CIRCLE, ARC, SPLINE or ELLIPSE
clauses.closed_outline: a simple closed contour on an outline layer (closed LWPOLYLINE/POLYLINE, or a closed LINE/ARC/open-SPLINE chain whose endpoints join within 0.05 mm and in which every vertex joins exactly two edges; never CIRCLE) that bounds the layer: its bounding box spans outline_coverage_min of the layer's bounding box in both axes, and at least outline_coverage_min of the layer's drawn length lies inside it or on it. Outline layer names match without case. Geometry model and the reason for each number: app/ci/dxf_catalog_geometry.py
clauses.preflight_valid: DXFPreflight (the runtime export gate's pre-check) reports no ERROR on the manufacturing view (reference layers removed)
clauses.topology_valid: TopologyValidator reports no ERROR on the manufacturing view, and a chained outline, its ARC and SPLINE edges read as curves, does not cross itself

manufacturing_body.description: Body outline assets that CAM may consume. Must be export-ready.

reference.description: Reference traces (blueprint extractions). No manufacturing-outline assertion.

class_rules.basis: body/dxf/{acoustic,electric,other}/ is the body-outline catalog read by instrument_geometry/body/outlines.py and catalog.json; '*' stays within one folder, so a DXF nested deeper under body/dxf/ is unclassified and fails until classified
reference_dxf/ holds blueprint reference traces (62 cuatro extractions, nested up to three levels)

layer_evidence.BODY_OUTLINE: outline layer of 20 body files; the R2000 GRBL pipeline verification (2026-04-29) generated G-code from BODY_OUTLINE (CLAUDE.md)
layer_evidence.BODY: sole outline layer of J45_body_outline*.dxf and Cuatro_Venezolano_body.dxf; body layer of flying_v_full.dxf
layer_evidence.GEOMETRY: layer read by the adaptive DXF CAM lane (routers/adaptive/dxf_router.py: closed LWPOLYLINE on layer GEOMETRY); outline layer of the four R12 POLYLINE bodies
layer_evidence.BODY_POINTS: reference/measurement data (owner ruling 2026-09-14). In all five files that carry it, it is one open LWPOLYLINE that revisits its own vertices 31-865 times next to a closed, valid BODY_OUTLINE (audit docs/investigations/dxf_gate_repair_audit_2026-09-14.md F4)
layer_evidence.not_declared: CUTOUT, OUTLINE, WIRING_CHANNEL and layer 0 are deliberately not outline or reference layers: their role has not been demonstrated (WIRING_CHANNEL awaits the CAM-consumer trace)
